defects.what: Back button touch target appears under 44px height (pill roughly ~36px tall) — violates touch target law
Test/QA placeholder data visible in a patient-facing browse screen ('QA Browser Hospital', 'QA City Hospital', 'QA Trial Clinic') — violates honesty law (real data only)
defects.where: Hospital list cards, rows 2-5 and below

defects.what: Duplicate hospital entries with identical names ('QA Browser Hospital' Surat, 'QA City Hospital' Ahmedabad) — looks like seeded test data, undermines trust

List is scrollable but the last visible card ('QA City Hospital', Ahmedabad) is cut off at screen bottom edge mid-content; not a defect per se but confirm list does not dead-end — flagged for verification, not truncation of text by the card itself

measured_notes: Count line reads '12 hospitals found' matching the stated contract of 12 real hospitals — count honesty looks correct
Gutters appear ~12-16px on left/right edges of the search field and cards — consistent with the 16px gutter law, no obvious mismatch
Card internal gaps between name/type/location/stats lines look ~4-6px, tighter than the 12px internal-gap spec for grouped content but visually consistent across all cards
No ellipsis/truncation observed on any hospital name, city, or type text — longest name 'QA Browser Hospital' fits fully
Search field height looks ~44-48px — passes touch target; 'All cities' chip looks ~36-40px tall, borderline
No teal accent visible on this screen; grey scale only — acceptable since no live/primary action is present on a browse list
Chevron affordance on each card is present and right-aligned, affordance clarity OK
Grey secondary text on white appears roughly #6b6b6b on #fff (~5:1) — passes AA; '12 hospitals found' line looks lighter grey, closer to ~#8a8a8a (~3.5:1) — borderline AA fail for small text
non_blocking_notes: Card radius consistent across all list cards; consistent rhythm maintained
Avatar initials circles are consistent size and correctly derived from names (CH, QB, QC, QT)
'0 doctors · 1 department' rows are honest empty-adjacent states, but a patient-facing improvement would be an explicit action hint; logged as copy consideration
'All cities' chip has no visible selected/unselected distinction beyond fill; minor affordance polish
one_line: Honest count and clean hierarchy, but QA test data leaking into a patient-facing screen is a blocking honesty failure, plus a borderline-contrast count line and sub-44px Back target.
